title: Karyotype of cultivated peanut (Arachis hypogaea)
description: Karyotype of cultivated peanut (Arachis hypogaea). Allotetraploid with an AABB genome (2n = 4x = 40). Genomes from A.duranensis (AA genome) in green and A. ipaënsis (BB genome) in red.
author: Patricia M Guimarães Olivier GarsmeurKarina ProiteSoraya CM Leal-BertioliGuilhermo SeijoChristian ChaineDavid J BertioliAngelique D'Hont
